title: Mutual-Friend Recommendations and Bounded Scores
prompt:
A friendship graph maps each string user ID to a collection of direct friends. Edges are undirected, there are no self-edges, and every referenced user appears as a key. Duplicate entries in an adjacency collection represent the same friendship.

Implement `recommend_friends(graph, user, k)`. Consider users connected to `user` through at least one mutual friend. Exclude `user` and all current direct friends. Return at most `k` tuples `(candidate_id, mutual_count, score)`, sorted by descending mutual count, then lexicographic candidate ID.

For this exercise, `score = mutual_count / number_of_direct_friends_of_user`. Each score must be in [0,1]. Return an empty list if there are no eligible candidates, the user has no friends, or `k == 0`. Assume `user` exists and `k` is a non-negative integer. Do not modify the input graph.

references.label: Original interview report — Applied MLE onsite AI coding

background_note: 原帖没有规定唯一归一化公式、输入格式或排序规则。练习版约定无向图，按共同好友数排序，再按 ID 打破平局；score = 共同好友数 / 目标用户好友数。NDCG 是作者讨论中的不明确提及，未确认为面试硬性子题，不单独拆题。
